alternatives.name: Keep typing module wrappers indefinitely
alternatives.description: Continue using typing.List, typing.Dict etc. rather than allowing list[int], dict[str, int] directly.
alternatives.reason_rejected: The typing module duplicates built-in types unnecessarily. Direct subscription of built-in types is more natural and reduces import burden.

objections.text: Deprecating typing.List etc. creates a migration burden for existing codebases with extensive type annotations.
